info.album: You Could Have Been With Me (Bonus Tracks Version)

podcast.body: Sheena Easton sang "For Your Eyes Only" as the title theme for the 1981 James Bond movie. This track continued the trend of mature, adult contemporary songs performed by female vocalists for the Bond franchise during the Roger Moore period. "Gina Easton with for your eyes only in 1981."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
